619-2174-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Juniper Order Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
619-2174-2645-3430.description:
Activate Dormant Volcano by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Dormant Volcano
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

5078-6289-7902.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Voyager Quickwelder.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1843-3259-7060.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1843-3259-7060.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tervigon, triggering Breath of Fury and Tervigon.
Resolve the Tervigon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2685-3197-3263-4017.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2685-3197-3263-4017.description:
Gain life in any way.
Herd Baloth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

215-4188-6965.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 6 life this turn.
215-4188-6965.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Accomplished Alchemist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Accomplished Alchemist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6792-7753.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-6792-7753.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mm'menon.
Repeat.

2034-5003-7732.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing S.H.I.E.L.D. Deployment Drone, adding {C}{C}.
When S.H.I.E.L.D. Deployment Drone dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return S.H.I.E.L.D. Deployment Drone from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When S.H.I.E.L.D. Deployment Drone enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2243-5856-5903.description:
Activate an artifact using Glittermonger's ability by tapping it, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat step 1 using the Treasure token.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2393-6972-7379.description:
Activate Zack by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When Zack dies, its persist ability and Sifter of Skulls triggers.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Zack from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the Zack ability from step 1.
Activate the Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

206-5921-5970-7014.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of North Pole Patrol.
Activate one of the North Pole Patrol tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other North Pole Patrol token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

206-1563-2457-4365.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1479-3257-7201.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3257-7201.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Sapling Nursery, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Sapling Nursery trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

775-1409-6441.description:
Activate Jewel Thief by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Jewel Thief enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Jewel Thief.
Resolve the Jewel Thief trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4091-5921-5970-6968.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Aphetto Alchemist.
Activate one of the Aphetto Alchemist tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Aphetto Alchemist token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

585-1399-1606-7069.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Tectonic Split
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and a land
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1329-3200-4785.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

631-1965-5220.description:
Cast Omarthis by paying {0}.
Omarthis enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Grim Haruspex.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Omarthis from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grim Haruspex trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Omarthis from your library.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

5295-5299-5921-5970--112.notablePrerequisites:
Mirror Room is locked.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
5295-5299-5921-5970--112.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a token copy of Marina.
Put the tapped Marina into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Marina token enters the battlefield, it's first ability triggers twice, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put all enchantment cards from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library, and then repeat this once.
Resolve the second Mirror Room trigger, creating a token copy of itself, as it is a creature due to Opalescence.
Activate the Marina token by tapping it, unlocking the token Mirror Room.
Repeat from step 2.
5295-5299-5921-5970--112.notes: The chosen anthem must increase the toughness of the Mirror Room token so it does not die as it enters the battlefield.

2493-3821-6485.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
2493-3821-6485.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Cast Rally the Galadhrim by paying {2}{G}{U} and tapping Archaeomancer and Peregrine Drake, targeting Archaeomancer
Rally the Galadhrim's conspire ability triggers, copying it, targeting Peregrine Drake.
Resolve the copy of Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the original Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer.
When the Archaeomancer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rally the Galadhrim from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, tapping the Archaeomancer and Peregrine Drake tokens when casting Rally the Galadhrim instead.

586-2511-5626-5687.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

813-1987-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
813-1987-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Scholar of the Ages and Peregrine Drake.
When Scholar of the Ages and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker and up to one instant or sorcery to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
813-1987-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

2174-2681-5881-5885.manaNeeded: {3}{R}{R}{G}{G}, plus an additional {2}{G} if you don't control a commander
2174-2681-5881-5885.notablePrerequisites: Anzrag and Juniper Order Druid do not have summoning sickness.
2174-2681-5881-5885.description:
Activate Anzrag by paying {3}{R}{R}{G}{G}, causing opponents to block Anzrag if able this turn.
Cast Obscuring Haze by paying {0} if you control a commander, or {2}{G} otherwise, preventing all combat damage that would be dealt by opposing creatures this turn.
Declare Anzrag as an attacker, attacking any opponent.
If the opponent does not control a creature, activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
If Forbidden Orchard was activated, it triggers, causing the defending opponent to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
If Forbidden Orchard was activated, activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Forbidden Orchard.
The opponent is forced to block Anzrag, triggering Anzrag, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Any combat damage that would be dealt to Anzrag is prevented by Obscuring Haze.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

851-2457-4772-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

3000-3188-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
3000-3188-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

678-914-4050.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least one artifact and/or enchantment.
678-914-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {R}.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Dockside Extortionist to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least one Treasure artifact token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
If opponents control two or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

224-1359-2366-5220-5256.notablePrerequisites: You are abile to play a land this turn.
224-1359-2366-5220-5256.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Dryad Arbor on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Dryad Arbor's power.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger from step 2, causing you to scry 1, ensuring to leave Dryad Arbor on top of your library.
Galadriel's second ability triggers, causing you to reveal Dryad Arbor from the top of your library, and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-5003-5024.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Soul of Migration, adding {C}{C}.
Soul of Migration dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Soul of Migration from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Soul of Migration enters the battlefield, creating two 1/1 Bird creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Bird, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

322-2557-2657-2757.notablePrerequisites:
You have a basic land card in hand.
You control a basic Forest.
322-2557-2657-2757.description:
Activate Ayula's Influence by discarding a basic land card, creating two 2/2 Bear creature tokens.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Bear, untapping a basic Forest you control.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat from step 2 one additional time.
Activate Groundskeeper by paying {1}{G}, returning a basic land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

618-2034-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Kiki-Jiki.
You control at least one nonlegendary creature.
618-2034-2178.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary creature you control with haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
The token dies, triggering Kiki-Jiki, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

2556-3742-4872.notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
2556-3742-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp, taking an extra turn after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall that is tapped and attacking.
Mnemonic Wall enters, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

618-957-3277.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing you to take two extra turns.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Izzet Chronarch with haste.
The token copy of Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

404-1115-1521-2105.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
404-1115-1521-2105.description:
Declare Flamerush Rider, Combat Celebrant and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant, Ghired's second ability and Flamerush Rider trigger.
Resolve the Flamerush Rider trigger, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Ghired trigger, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare the Combat Celebrant token created in step 4 and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
Repeat from step 4.
Optionally, you may also attack with Flamerush Rider to get infinite copies of any other attacking creatures you control.

224-433-4300.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
224-433-4300.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Repeat.

2882-4675-4809.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
2882-4675-4809.description:
Cast Shifting Wall by paying {0}.
Shifting Wall enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Shifting Wall from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

92-2298-3591.notablePrerequisites: Each opponent has a life total that is less than forty.
92-2298-3591.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage by paying {1}{W}{B}, causing each opponent to lose life whenever you gain life this turn.
Activate Necropotence by paying 1 life, exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat step 2 until you have one life.
Cast Oketra's Last Mercy by paying {1}{W}{W}, causing your life total to become forty.
Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose thirty-nine life.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
